links.outcome: Physician-rated factuality of retrieval-augmented LLM versus standard LLMs on clinical scenarios
links.effect: Significant increases in factuality (mean of 18% at p-value < 0.05) across all specialties, with improvements in completeness and safety.
links.quote: Performance on a novel dataset of clinical scenarios (n = 130) evaluated by a panel of 5 board-certified and resident physicians demonstrates significant increases in factuality (mean of 18% at p-value < 0.05) across all specialties, with improvements in completeness and safety.
